messages:
jordan: Quick round from today's usability session — users tripped over the stop/regenerate flow again. many tried double-tap to stop and then expected a separate regenerate button. attached notes: https://img.redwood/mock/session-notes.png

maya: Noted. I think the root is the single-action affordance. Can we show Stop (prominent) while streaming, then replace with a clear Regenerate button + small Resume (if cached) after stop?

devon: Implementation wise: while streaming expose 2 actions: [Stop streaming] (primary) and tiny [Copy]. After stream end swap primary -> [Regenerate] and add [Resume] if KV exists. Resume should attach cached prefix to avoid model cold-start.

sam: Token meter UX: testers misread the meter color change as an error on high token usage. Suggest switching to neutral color progression and only highlight on quota-critical thresholds. Also the counter label needs to be explicit: "Prompt | Response" not ambiguous.

jordan: Accessibility followups: 1) aria-live region should be aria-atomic=true so screen readers get the final text once. 2) Make sure focus returns to the message region on Stop so keyboard users can copy text without hunting.

maya: Copy tweak: tooltip for counters -> "Response tokens (generated by model) — excludes prompt tokens". Also change button label to "Stop streaming" on wide screens; keep icon + sr-only label on mobile.

devon: Perf note: streaming updates are causing layout churn because we recompute token meter width every append. will cache meter widths and only recalc on resize or message boundary. PR incoming.

ui-bot: preview for branch playground/ux-stop-regen created: https://preview.redwood/playground-ux-stop-regen (screenshots attached) :sparkles:

jordan: Acceptance checklist for the PR:
- Stop action distinct from Regenerate after stream ends
- Resume uses KV cache when available to avoid full regen latency
- Focus returns to message region and caret/selection preserved
- Screen reader announces final response once (aria-atomic) and token totals exposed to assistive tech
- Token meter only highlights on quota thresholds and tooltip clarifies counters

maya: tagging @devon to add notes to PR and @sam for a11y review. I'll update the figma frames for the after-stream state.
